_meta.about: Flock-model additions to results/vehicle_params.json (sister-project file, unchanged). Tags: [opened] read from the opened source; DERIVED computed from opened numbers; ASSUMPTION engineering choice.

max_tilt_rad.note: roll/pitch limit of the stock velocity controller

tau_att_s.note: closed-loop attitude ~ first order with tau = 1/Kp when the inner rate loop is much faster; approximation, not a measured step response

kv_per_s.note: small-angle conversion a = g*theta; P only (firmware also has KI 1.0)

drag_quad_Nsm2m2.source: ASSUMPTION: 0.5*rho*Cd*A, rho 1.225 kg/m^3, Cd 1.0, A 1.5e-3 m^2
drag_quad_Nsm2m2.note: body pressure drag |v|v on top of Förster's linear rotor drag (fitted at 2.25-4.25 m/s, so partly double-counted there); it bounds the terminal speed

v_cruise_mps.note: firmware position mode defaults to 1 m/s (PID_POS_VEL_X_MAX 1.0f, [opened]); 3 m/s finishes a 600 m leg in 200 s

v_max_mps.note: below the drag-limited terminal speed at max tilt (vehicle.py self-check)

thrust_max_check_N.note: cross-check only: whole-vehicle thrust at 93.75 % PWM; the model uses 4 f_max from the sister file (Förster eq. 3.3 at full command)
